identity.login.title: Sign in to Tokenhood
identity.login.lead: Tokenhood identifies you through your GitHub account. One sign-in lets you contribute, maintain a project and take part in governance.
identity.login.scopes: Tokenhood asks GitHub for your public profile (read:user) and your email addresses (user:email), only to check that your primary address is verified. It keeps neither your GitHub token nor your address.
identity.login.unavailable.title: Sign-in unavailable
identity.login.unavailable.body: Sign-in with GitHub is not configured on this instance yet. Please come back a little later.
identity.login.errors.stateInvalid: The sign-in request expired or is no longer valid. Please start again.
identity.login.errors.denied: You declined access to your GitHub account: no data was read.
identity.login.errors.emailUnverified: Your GitHub account has no verified primary email address. Verify it in your GitHub settings, then sign in again.
identity.login.errors.exchangeFailed: GitHub did not confirm the sign-in. Try again in a moment.
identity.login.errors.profileFailed: Your GitHub profile could not be read. Try again in a moment.
